objective: Prevent background/frozen dashboard screens from initiating AdMob SDK requests during navigation, reduce redundant per-slot AppState listeners, and preserve already loaded creatives and existing ad safety/cooldown rules.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main 69ff92b22b13e26490a93f685ebc89d28e3d6cbf checked Nov16 2026. Latest Supabase native app operational events over last 60min (1.3.6 build30 runtime1.3.2) show 14 NativeAd requests, 4 native failures incl NATIVE_AD_LOAD_TIMEOUT, 6 banner requests and 1 banner no-fill; callbacks for certain placement IDs appear on different routes. This telemetry cannot prove the exact served production OTA fingerprint or on-device navigation latency. Last documented served Expo production update 01a1da5c-0179-79fc-85c9-591cdb782190; later production publish outcome not independently verified. No RC or production release claimed.
chosenApproach: Apply focus-aware request gates to existing Android NativeAd and banner slots while retaining loaded SDK media; drop success-path resume listeners, guard cooldown state after blur, and key only the wide header ad by its actual placement.
selectionRationale: Preserves first-view prefetch and filled creatives, prevents offscreen requests and repeated native remounts, and isolates changes to three ad components; does not alter global AdMob IDs, consent, frequency, auth, network, or routing.
alternativeApproaches: Unconditionally unmount all ads on each dashboard switch (rejected: refill latency, cooldown starvation, possible duplicate SDK requests)
Decrease banner/native ad exposure or disable prefetch (rejected: reduced fill and contradicts approved first-view monetization)
preserveBehaviors: Native Android Expo runtime 1.3.2, production channel, build identity and all configured AdMob units unchanged.
Existing genuine SDK impression reporting, UMP consent, live no-fill handling and shared request cooldown unchanged.
Existing Android first-view prefetch allowed only on the focused screen; already loaded SDK creative retained across blur.
Existing no-hidden NativeAdView before real visibility, video quality and scroll-stop, Connect/PTT, Wall, Profile, Finance/QMP and privacy unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Native and banner may start SDK requests on focused screens only; frozen dashboards cannot start new requests.
Native prefetch still supports near-visible assets and never mounts SDK creative before viewability.
Already-loaded creatives remain available after re-entry without forced reload; expired cooldown recovers failed inventory.
Healthy ad slots do not register per-card AppState resume handlers.
Focused Node tests and all existing protected-feature/CI gates pass before an RC or production OTA is considered.
Mandatory existing appwide ad contract exercised in PR, compiled RC and production OTA prevents future loss of dashboard focus guards.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Focus-sensitive lifecycle gates affect Android advertising component render work.
preservedBehaviors: No native runtime, package, auth, media, or backend changes.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: AdMob NativeAd/banner startup and recovery constrained by the actual focused dashboard.
preservedBehaviors: Same ad units, consent, telemetry, cooldown and separate Finance/QMP rules.
